verdict.rationale: Gitea's core purpose is Git repo hosting with commit history browsing, code review, and branch management, confirmed by first-party docs and corroborated by extensive hands-on community use (self-hosting for teams, private repo creation, browsing). One minor gap noted by a hands-on report: browsing commit history/Activity on large repos can be slow due to lack of caching. missing for 10: independent benchmark confirming commit history browsing performance at scale, deeper detail on repo creation workflow.
